info.name: Act1_Notion_Authorization
info.description: Authorization verification collection for Notion REST API v1 (Notion-Version: 2025-09-03) - SQE III, Lab 02, Group 2 (Activity #1, Item 3). Demonstrates Notion's dual authorization architecture: Bearer Token for Internal Integrations and HTTP Basic Auth (RFC 7617) for OAuth 2.0 lifecycle endpoints in Public Integrations.

item.name: 01_Bearer_Token_Auth (Internal Integration)
Auth Check - GET Retrieve token's bot user (Valid Token)

header.description: Mandatory Notion API contract version header.

request.description: Validates successful authorization (200 OK) by inheriting the Bearer Token scheme ({{NOTION_TOKEN}}) from the parent folder. Returns the bot user object linked to the team's internal integration.

item.name: Auth Check - GET Retrieve token's bot user (Invalid Token - 401)

header.description: Mandatory Notion API contract version header.
Overrides inherited authorization with an invalid token to demonstrate 401 Unauthorized rejection.

request.description: Demonstrates negative access control by overriding the Authorization header with an invalid credential (secret_invalid_token_123). Notion API deterministically rejects the request with HTTP 401 Unauthorized and code: "unauthorized".

item.description: Bearer Token authorization scheme (Authorization: Bearer {{NOTION_TOKEN}}) used by internal integrations and active access tokens to consume Notion domain resources (/v1/users, /v1/pages, /v1/databases, /v1/data_sources, /v1/blocks, /v1/comments, /v1/search, and /v1/file_uploads).

item.name: 02_OAuth2_Basic_Auth (Public Integration)
OAuth Auth Check - POST Introspect Token

header.description: Mandatory Notion API contract version header.

request.description: Inspects the active status (active: true/false) of an access token per RFC 7662 while authenticating the client application via HTTP Basic Auth (base64(OAUTH_CLIENT_ID:OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET)).

item.name: OAuth Auth Check - POST Exchange Token

header.description: Mandatory Notion API contract version header.

request.description: Exchanges a temporary single-use OAuth 2.0 authorization code (authorization_code) for an active access_token, inheriting HTTP Basic Auth client credentials from the parent folder.

item.description: HTTP Basic Auth authorization scheme (Authorization: Basic base64(client_id:client_secret)) strictly required by Notion OAuth 2.0 management endpoints (/v1/oauth/token, /v1/oauth/introspect, and /v1/oauth/revoke).
